notice.title: TGEdCET-2026 Cat ‘B’ Management Quota Notification Guidelines and Rules

registration_deadline.evidence: iv) Last date for uploading details of Management of seats in the web portal without Late fee (Rs. 500/- per candidate)

clauses.text: Candidate should have passed the qualifying examination and shall satisfy the following eligibility criteria for admissions

Candidates should have secured 50% of marks either in the Bachelor’s Degree i.e., B.A. / B.Com/ B.Sc. (Home Science)/ BCA/BBM, B.A. (Oriental languages),BBA, Engineering or in the Master’s Degree or any other qualifications equivalent thereto
However, the candidates belonging to reserved categories Viz., SC/ST/BC and other reserved categories should have secured 40% in the qualifying examinations
